gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-krub: Krub moves quickly, its tall x-height, plus loops left unfinished on the curves, keeping the plain sans text light. And Eight Bit Dragon strides above it, widely spaced and towering, a swagger Krub never tries to match.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-kufam: A wide stride, a towering lowercase: Eight Bit Dragon looks ready for adventure. Kufam follows with one tube-like line width, generously open e curves, and bodies that dominate each line, so text moves smoothly.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-lexend: Lexend is an outsized sans, its curves all open jaws. Text runs smoothly in it, while Eight Bit Dragon brings a measured weight shift, thread against yarn, to the headings.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-lexend-de: Lexend Deca draws a plain, unshaded line, its terminals stopping short of curling back. Lexend Deca's quiet restraint is the best part, leaving Eight Bit Dragon's stencil-cut, adventurous letters all the attention.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-miriam-li: Wide-striding and tall, Eight Bit Dragon pinches slightly where curves meet stems. And Miriam Libre, with the weight of drawn wire and a lowercase of cast-iron stature, steadies it.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mochiy-po: Eight Bit Dragon strides across widely separated letters, towering in lowercase. Mochiy Pop P One counters with one flat line weight and generous spacing, which does the quiet work of reading.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-mozilla-t: Big-bodied lowercase gives this plain sans a bold look, its terminals flaring outward. Mozilla Text stays quiet under Eight Bit Dragon's adventurous, widely spaced heading, whose curves carry a faint taffy-like swell.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-nobile: Professional and contemporary, Nobile stays tight between lowercase and caps. Eight Bit Dragon, widely spaced and towering, loses some stride if made small, while Nobile's open mouths stay readable.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-noto-kufi: Noto Kufi Arabic keeps a modern, clean face, with a welcoming gap in the c. But Eight Bit Dragon handles the swagger, its tapered strokes like glass rods, while the plain sans quietly carries the text.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-noto-sans: Eight Bit Dragon strides wide, its strokes mildly pen-like and its lowercase towering. Noto Sans backs it up with lowercase filling most of the letter height and a wide-open c.
